title: North Yorkshire Council: Using AI to reimagine Children’s Social Care
summary: North Yorkshire reports 90% less time and cost for some data-retrieval tasks in its Azure AI proof of concept, plus relationship-mapping tools.
account: North Yorkshire developed an Azure AI proof of concept for semantic search and relationship maps in children's social-care records. Some data-retrieval tasks reportedly required 90% less time and cost in testing. Operational adoption and improved safeguarding outcomes remain unverified.
purpose: Improve retrieval and interpretation of children’s social-care records, including relationships among people and cases.
system: Microsoft Azure AI proof of concept for semantic search and automatically generated eco-maps in Liquidlogic LCS records
developer: North Yorkshire Council using Microsoft Azure AI

ratings.reason: Selected retrieval tasks reportedly cost less and take less time in testing. Savings across deployed services are unmeasured.
